case.summary: The alert was triggered when customer C11923 reported that they never made the $131.30 online purchase (transaction 3583368) on their visa debit card C11923-K2. The strongest finding is that the rare device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | | chrome 66.0 for android |, used on only four cards, was also used on three other cards within 30 days, with one of those transactions matching the amount within 2 %; additionally, in the bank's closed cases every customer-reported alert of this type was confirmed fraud. The case verdict is fraud with a probability of 0.96. The recommended actions are to block the card, create a case file, file a report, and monitor the connected cards.

sar.narrative: This report concerns customer C11923, card C11923-K2, issued as a visa debit. On 2016-12-29, 1 transaction(s) totalling $131.30 were identified as part of one fraud episode, beginning with transaction 3583368. The activity took place online, product code(s) C, from device profile(s) SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android | . The transactions were purchases from one device profile used across several customers' cards. The activity is assessed as card-not-present fraud from a device new to the account: Rare device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android |  (4 cards ever) was used on 3 other cards within 30 days, 1 of them for amounts within 2% of this $131.30 purchase (in the closed months this shape was 6.8 times more common in confirmed fraud than in normal online traffic); Customer C11923 disputes transaction 3583368 ($131.30); in the bank's closed cases every customer-reported alert was confirmed fraud. The same device profile SM-G610F Build/NRD90M |  | chrome 66.0 for android |  links this activity to 3 other card(s), including C03938-K1, C05595-K1, C05678-K1, which indicates a common actor across cardholders. Earlier confirmed cases CC-3683, CC-2198, CC-2244 show the same pattern. The cardholder reported the disputed transaction to the bank and denied making it. The bank has recommended BLOCK_CARD, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS and opened an internal case; the report is filed under R6, §3a.
